description: Return a fast, zero-argument health overview of the running Cruma agent. Reports an overall status (ok / degraded / critical) and a structured list of active issues across: hosted-process health (crashes, backoff, start failures), listener binding failures, config validation errors, certificate expiry or ACME failures, tunnel connectivity, and HTTP error rates from the last 10 minutes. Use this as the first call when troubleshooting — it bootstraps context before diving into specific tools.
name: get_health_summary
